title: Owner
intro: Whoever owns a project can give it to someone who can see the machine. The receiver must accept. The owner of the machine can take back anything inside it.
mineDefault: You own this object as owner of the machine.
cascade: Apply to everything of this kind that concerns me on this machine
nobody: No such person on this machine.
withNotes: Hand over my private notes on it too
code: Second-factor code (if your account has one)
takeHint: Gifts naming these objects are withdrawn. Private notes are never taken.
noneReceived: No gift is waiting for you.
noneSent: You have no gift waiting for an answer.
notesIncluded: The giver also hands over their notes on these objects.
giftSent: Gift sent. Nothing changes until it is accepted.
